import sys,importlib.util,hashlib,unittest,json
from pathlib import Path
src=Path(sys.argv[1]); test=Path(sys.argv[2])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("review_convergence",src)
ev=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules["review_convergence"]=ev;spec.loader.exec_module(ev)
print(json.dumps({"loaded_module":ev.__file__,"module_sha256":hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"case_source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(test.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}),flush=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("paired_tests",test)
t=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(t)
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(t));sys.exit(not r.wasSuccessful())

environment.network: none; tests use local tempfile only
